title: Keep conversations responsive during active execution
what: Explicit !status, !stop, !continue and !steer controls are implemented through native Pi state/inbox and durable delivery. Local workerd verifies status during active execution, stop completion, duplicate receipts, prompt-free controls, and rejection of steering while cancellation is pending. Production Slack delivery, gated long-tool/restart cases, natural-language side questions, and automatic progress remain incomplete; see docs/devin-parity.md.

acceptance.text: A status or side question receives an answer before a gated long-running tool finishes
Read-only side answers cannot edit files or mutate the running task
Steering reaches the active operation at a safe boundary rather than silently becoming a separate queued task
Stop and resume report their real execution state and preserve completed side effects
Different authorized workspace members can participate in the same thread
Restart and duplicate events do not lose instructions or create duplicate work
